finding.title: Execution from a writable temp location
finding.subject: /tmp/
why: the program was started from /tmp/, a directory any program can write to
benign: an installer or build tool you ran unpacks and runs helpers from a temp directory

finding.title: Credential file read
finding.subject: ssh_keys
why: this file holds a private SSH key
the program is not on the allowlist for ssh_keys
the program does not run from a root-owned system directory
benign: you ran a backup, sync or key-management tool yourself
